Data:Chat.mrs.k.block.json.label: Mrs Kille is absent
Data:Chat.mrs.k.block.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille is absent... on the Librarian's business. But I already knew that, didn't I?

Data:Chat.mrs.k.friend.json.label: Speak with Mrs Kille
Data:Chat.mrs.k.friend.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille's mood always improves when I drop by. [If you don't choose a topic, Mrs Kille will offer help, as a friend.]
Data:Chat.mrs.k.friend.json.desc: 'Well, you can't get feathers off a toad.'

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Mrs Kille about something specific; or leave this empty to wait until she's free and can lend her assistance.

Data:Chat.mrs.k.json.label: Speak with Mrs Kille
Data:Chat.mrs.k.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille likes conversations about beginnings. (Her husband prefers to talk about endings.) A shilling will buy her help for a day.
Data:Chat.mrs.k.json.desc: 'Well, you can't get feathers off a toad.'

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Mrs Kille about something specific; or offer him payment for her help.

Data:Chat.rectory.block.json.label: Reverend Timothy is absent
Data:Chat.rectory.block.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy is absent... on the Librarian's business. But I already knew that, didn't I?

Data:Chat.rectory.friend.json.label: Speak with Reverend Timothy
Data:Chat.rectory.friend.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy's door is always open to me. [Timothy will offer help for free, as a friend.]

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Reverend Timothy about something specific; or leave this empty to wait for him to finish with his correspondence and lend his assistance.

Data:Chat.rectory.json.label: Speak with Reverend Timothy
Data:Chat.rectory.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy enjoys thoughtful conversation, prayer, and tea. And he'll offer his assistance in return for a one-shilling donation to church funds.

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Reverend Timothy about something specific; or offer him payment for his help.

Data:Chat.smithy.block.json.label: Denzil is absent
Data:Chat.smithy.block.json.startdescription: The smith is absent... on the Librarian's business. But I already knew that, didn't I?

Data:Chat.smithy.friend.json.label: Speak with Denzil
Data:Chat.smithy.friend.json.startdescription: I'm always welcome at Denzil's smithy. [Denzil will offer help for free, as a friend. If you give him occult coinage, he will perform the Service of Division.]

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: [Ask Denzil about something specific; or leave this empty to wait for him to finish at his anvil and lend you his assistance.]

Data:Chat.smithy.json.label: Speak with Denzil
Data:Chat.smithy.json.startdescription: Denzil will talk about practical matters, though he prefers to sit in silence. A shilling will buy his help for a day. [If you give him occult coinage, he will perform the Service of Division instead.]

slots.label: Topic
slots.description: Ask Denzil about something specific; or offer him payment for his help.

xexts.scrutiny: The white queen and black king are both scowling. But the black queen and white king are both grinning delightedly.

Data:Chest.souvenirs.json.Label: Souvenir Cache
Data:Chest.souvenirs.json.Desc: Memories tidily tucked away until now.

Data:Chicken.terrence.json.Label: Terrence, the Chicken
Data:Chicken.terrence.json.Desc: Was this magnificent and indomitable beast named for the rector's indomitable and magnificent housekeeper? Best not to inquire too closely.

Data:Chicken.tuppence.json.Label: Tuppence, the Other Chicken
Data:Chicken.tuppence.json.Desc: Tuppence's most notable quality, all observers will agree, is that she is not Terrence.

Data:Chips.game.json.Label: Game Chips
Data:Chips.game.json.Desc: Long before fish and chips, these went crunchily with game. Ideally you'd want bread sauce and breadcrumbs to complete the ensemble, but honestly it's hard enough not just to stuff these directly into your mouth.

Data:Chronsicord.json.Label: Chronsichord
Data:Chronsicord.json.Desc: A music-box that only performs once; a typewriter that can only send one message; a clock that can only strike Now.

xexts.scrutiny: A whirl of motion; a series of clicks; then silence. [There are Keeper-level Knock recipes that can craft this from Gervinite.]

Data:Cinnabar.json.Label: Cinnabar
Data:Cinnabar.json.Desc: A bright scarlet powder with a silvery brilliance locked within.

Data:Circ.depths.uncovered.json.label: Uncovered Depths
Data:Circ.depths.uncovered.json.desc: Once more, the sea has withdrawn from the caves of the Isle.

Data:Circ.waters.receding.json.label: Receding Waters
Data:Circ.waters.receding.json.desc: Once more, the waters are in retreat in the lower levels of the House.

Data:Circumstance.json.label: Circumstance
Data:Circumstance.json.desc: Something that is so, but only for now. [Circumstances disappear in the season of Numa.]

Data:Clean.thing.generic.sweetbones.json.label: Have Something Cleaned at the Sweet Bones
Data:Clean.thing.generic.sweetbones.json.startdescription: The Sweet Bones is taking care of my laundry.

Data:Clean.thing.generic.sweetbones.try..label: Have Something Cleaned at the Sweet Bones
Data:Clean.thing.generic.sweetbones.try..startdescription: For a shilling, the Sweet Bones will take care of my laundry...

Data:Clock.artdeco.json.Label: Brazen Clock
Data:Clock.artdeco.json.Desc: It's not immediately apparent that this clock lacks hands, although, when wound, it dutifully ticks.

xexts.scrutiny: An inscription reads: 'For D.M. Time is; Time was; Time is past.'

Data:Clock.forge.json.Label: Daybreak Clock
Data:Clock.forge.json.Desc: A particularly unrepentant example of the roccoco style of the mid-eighteenth century.

xexts.scrutiny: Ambrose Westcott loved this clock. Most of his successors thought it was hideous, so it's been quietly shuffled from room to room where they didn't have to look at it, until it ended up here.

Data:Clock.knock.json.Label: Stepstrike Clock
Data:Clock.knock.json.Desc: Tuned in an unlikely city to ensure its chimes attract the attention of the unseen.

xexts.scrutiny: After dark, it attracts extra echoes.

Data:Clock.lantern.json.Label: Masquewatch Clock
Data:Clock.lantern.json.Desc: Reputedly crafted for the Masque of Masques during the Great Writhing.

xexts.scrutiny: A handle that looks like a pull-repeat - to strike the hour again - produces only a discouraging rustling sound…

Data:Clock.librarian.json.Label: Librarian's Timepiece
Data:Clock.librarian.json.Desc: One of Ambrose Westcott's appalling roccoco enthusiasms. This one, less ugly than some, was suffered to remain by his sentimental successors.

Data:Clock.moon.json.Label: Ninewink Clock
Data:Clock.moon.json.Desc: The most effective and irrefutable alarm clock ever to grace the House.

xexts.scrutiny: The alarm can only be switched off with a particular rotation of the key. Lazier Librarians have found it easier just to let the thing run down.

Data:Clock.servants.json.Label: Inscribed Clock
Data:Clock.servants.json.Desc: A gift from Sir David Greene to a favoured retainer.

Data:Cockatoo.green.hungry.json.Desc: On numerous occasions, this wonderful bird has remained almost entirely inaudible.

xexts.scrutiny: This proud bird strongly resembles a painting in the Gullscry Tower. But that painting is two hundred years old. Cockatoos are long-lived birds, but not that long; and they can be difficult to tell apart.

Data:Cockatoo.green.json.Label: Magnificent Green Cockatoo
Data:Cockatoo.green.json.Desc: On numerous occasions, this wonderful bird has remained almost entirely inaudible.

xexts.scrutiny: This proud bird strongly resembles a painting in the Gullscry Tower. But that painting is two hundred years old. Cockatoos are long-lived birds, but not that long; and they can be difficult to tell apart.

Data:Codex.json.label: Codex
Data:Codex.json.desc: Pages, cover, spine, knowledge decently tucked away like organs.

Data:Collaborate.xcho.json.label: Collaborate: Chor
Data:Collaborate.xcho.json.startdescription: Everything goes easier with a song. [Boosts Heart and Grail]
Data:Collaborate.xcho.json.desc: My assistant and I are both a little merrier.
